headline: Mooring and Marban Flare as Passage Falls Silent
war_summary: Since the last wire the storm has shifted to Mooring County and Marban Hollow, both filing to the hour. Mooring stands nine Warden, two Colonial and one in ruins after eleven changes in two hours and fifty-six on the day about Gravekeeper's Holdfast, the Wind Hills and MacConmara Barrows amid 6,740 Colonial and 6,531 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours with rates quickening. Marban Hollow stands one Warden, six Colonial and one in ruins after eleven changes in two hours and thirteen on the day centred on Checkpoint Bua amid 758 and 1,018 lost. The Weathered Expanse now shows one Warden, six Colonial and two in ruins after one change in two hours and eighty-six on the day about Wightwalk and Crow's Nest with 7,323 and 10,617 lost. Callahan's Passage at ten to none, the Nevish Line at seven to one, and Gutter have recorded no change in two hours, while Olavis Wake reports five changes at Koskinla with 812 and 917 lost.
